concept: Maintaining physical health as a foundation for everything else, especially when work and life get demanding
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult's demanding job or family life has crowded out physical activity and self-care
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's the real cost of letting this slide, and what's a realistic way back in?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one small, sustainable change given their actual schedule

assessment.success_marker: adult proposes a specific, realistic change rather than an idealized routine they won't sustain
